hook.text: In 1990 they were almost equal. Who's richest today?

beat0.text: In 1990, all three were under 400 dollars per person.

beat1.text: Through the two thousands, Pakistan and India stayed neck and neck.

beat2.text: Then Bangladesh, the poorest of the three in 1990, overtook both by 2019.

beat3.text: In 2025, India is at about 2,700 dollars, Bangladesh 2,600, and Pakistan 1,600.

takeaway.text: Same starting line. Very different paths.

cta.text: Which number surprised you? Follow for more data stories.
